================================================================================
cpath pointer arithmetic dereference preserves assignment and cast operands
================================================================================
unsafe class C {
    int M(int* p, int i) {
        *(p + i) = i;
        return *((int*)p + i);
    }
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (class_declaration
    (modifier)
    (identifier)
    (declaration_list
      (method_declaration
        (predefined_type)
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list
          (parameter
            (pointer_type
              (predefined_type))
            (identifier))
          (parameter
            (predefined_type)
            (identifier)))
        (block
          (expression_statement
            (assignment_expression
              (prefix_unary_expression
                (parenthesized_expression
                  (binary_expression
                    (identifier)
                    (identifier))))
              (identifier)))
          (return_statement
            (prefix_unary_expression
              (parenthesized_expression
                (binary_expression
                  (cast_expression
                    (pointer_type
                      (predefined_type))
                    (identifier))
                  (identifier))))))))))
